page.layout: One column of names, arranged by year (years in the left margin, one group per year), with marginal notes in the right margin. Printed page number at the head. Section mark § 2 at the foot.

main_text.l: Pactio civitatis Gron. cum collegio Vltr. de præfectura suburbana.Berent Hornekinck.
Frisii ab Alberto Bavaro ad Scoterfilam cæsi.Sweder van Winde.

page.notes: The years 1391–1397 stand in the left margin beside their groups; they are written here as the first item of each group. The rendering of the names follows the print (e.g. "Jarch", "Johan", "Everdes-f."). The stroke over "Johan" and "Berent" is printer's abbreviation for n and is not reproduced. The notes in the right margin are placed beside the lines where they stand. The running head is absent.
